project_type: Monorepo with React Native (Expo) mobile apps and React+Vite web dashboards
build_system: Expo for mobile apps (passenger-app, driver-app). Vite+React for web apps (admin-panel, operator-dashboard). No workspace-level build orchestrator.
test_framework: Jest for api-gateway. No test frameworks currently configured for the mobile/web apps.
build_command: Per-app: cd apps/<app-name> && npm run build (or expo build for mobile)
test_command: No app-level tests currently exist. API has: cd services/api-gateway && npm test
verification_instructions: 1. Start each app in dev mode and verify navigation works. 2. For passenger-app and driver-app: npx expo start, then test on simulator/device. 3. For admin-panel and operator-dashboard: npm run dev, then open browser. 4. Verify all tabs/screens are accessible, i18n keys resolve correctly in both English and Swahili.
environment_constraints: React Native apps use Expo SDK 51 with React Navigation v6. Both use @react-navigation/bottom-tabs. Web apps use react-router-dom v6 with sidebar navigation. No live reload issues known. Maintain existing navigation library versions.
contribution_requirements: Use TypeScript strict mode where already enabled. Follow existing code style (functional components, hooks). Preserve all existing features and routes. Match existing i18n patterns (passenger-app uses custom i18n module, driver-app uses react-i18next, admin and operator use react-i18next or inline resources). No breaking API changes.
key_patterns: Passenger-app: Stack navigator with drawer-style MainScreen, no bottom tabs currently. Driver-app: Bottom tabs (Home, Trips, Earnings, Profile) with nested stacks. Admin-panel: react-router with sidebar Layout, routes defined in App.tsx. Operator-dashboard: react-router with Tailwind-styled Sidebar, Lucide icons. All apps support English/Swahili i18n.
directory_structure: apps/passenger-app: screens/ (all screens flat), i18n/ (en.json, sw.json). apps/driver-app: src/screens/ organized by category (main/, trip/, profile/), src/navigation/ (navigators), src/i18n/locales/. apps/admin-panel: src/pages/ (flat), src/components/ (Layout, RequireAuth), src/i18n.ts (inline resources). apps/operator-dashboard: src/pages/ (flat), src/components/ (Sidebar, Layout), src/i18n/ (en.json, sw.json).
